instruction: Repair the demonstrated image-production failure mechanism before authorizing another native image attempt. Preserve every accepted_locked image and all completed upstream tasks. For subject/context defects, require a fresh single-story worker using only the sealed image specification and prohibit orchestration/dashboard context leakage. For people/avatar defects, replace people/humanoid visual primitives with non-human artifacts such as documents, checklists, folders, role cards, process tokens or abstract symbols. For exact-PNG persistence defects, prove one approved exact-byte transport route end-to-end before generation. Put the repair through protected CI, record the operational-learning problem/fix/outcome, then create one bounded post-repair epoch for only the blocked candidate.
